==Trivia==
*In a franchise first, this season featured double the normal amount of male Casa Amor islanders, with a total of 12. Meanwhile, only 6 female islanders entered Casa Amor.

===Controversies===
*Just three days before the season was due to air, Vasana was pulled from the original line-up after videos of her saying a racial slur surfaced online.<ref>https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/love-island-usa-vasana-montgomery-n-word-1236763251/</ref> As a result, Gabriel entered as a bombshell instead due to uneven numbers.
*Following the premiere of episode 17, evidence of Casa Amor islander Alannah using a racial slur surfaced online.<ref>https://pagesix.com/2026/06/22/entertainment/love-island-usa-bombshell-alannah-keyser-faces-backlash-for-using-n-word-in-resurfaced-video/</ref> She was subsequently edited out and removed from the villa.<ref>https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/love-island-usa-casa-amor-alannah-keyser-n-word-1236787570/</ref>
